POWER RESTORATION UPDATE
Affected Areas: 
Portion of AF7 - Portion of Mansilingan Subd., Ta-ala Farms Inc., Kabugwason.
Portion of AF8 - One Communities Subdivision. 
Portion of AF7 - East Homes Phase 4, 5, 6, South Spring Village, Villa Maria Reyna Subd., Sunny Plains Subd., Prk Totong, Hda. Edmar, Brgy. Felisa.
Portion of AF8 - NGO Village, Handumanan (Handumanan Elem. School, Handumanan National High School until 7/11 Felisa), Villasor  Village, Purok Ceres Ph III.
Restored at 6:07PM
We sincerely thank our valued consumers for your patience and continued support throughout the restoration process.
If you are still experiencing a power outage, kindly send us your account details and contact number so we can assist you as soon as possible. 
Thank you for your patience and understanding.

SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: SEPTEMBER 26, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa September 26, 2026 (Saturday).
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: September 26, 2026 (Saturday)
Reason: 
● Reconductoring of 1.9  km 3Ph 2/0 Primary line to 336.4 Tree Wire from South Spring Village-Bangga Totong-7/11 Handumanam and Savemore to Handumanan National Highschool; 
● Massive Insulator Replacement East Homes 5;and
● Replacement/relocation of pole, installation of rubber insert, DT & FCO covers, bail clamps.
Time & Affected Areas:
6:00AM to 7:00AM & 5:00PM to 6:00PM
Portion of AF7 - Portion of Mansilingan Subd., Ta-ala Farms Inc., Kabugwason.
Portion of AF8 - One Communities Subdivision.
6:00AM to 6:00PM
Portion of AF7 - East Homes Phase 4, 5, 6, South Spring Village, Villa Maria Reyna Subd., Sunny Plains Subd., Prk Totong, Hda. Edmar, Brgy. Felisa.
Portion of AF8 - NGO Village, Handumanan (Handumanan Elem. School, Handumanan National High School until 7/11 Felisa), Villasor  Village, Purok Ceres Ph III.
Madamo gid nga salamat sa inyo nga pag hangop.
